component.name: Echoes
component.summary: Offline-first, end-to-end encrypted notes synced over Nostr

description.p: Echoes is a notes app that treats the network as optional. Every note, checklist, image, and voice memo is saved locally first and stays fully usable with no connection at all. Syncing to Nostr relays is a separate, explicit action — never automatic, never required — and everything that leaves the device is encrypted before it goes: note content is NIP-44 self-encrypted, and image/voice attachments are AES-256-GCM encrypted client-side before upload, so relay operators and file hosts only ever see opaque ciphertext.

ul.li: Offline-first — notes stay readable and writable with no network
Private Nostr sync, opt-in per note or in bulk
Client-side encrypted image and voice attachments
Diary mode — date-tagged entries in a day-grouped timeline
Bring your own relays and attachment host
List or masonry grid layouts, light/dark themes

description.p: Fixes drag-and-drop note reordering, which could pick a note up but never drop it: only the dragged card was a valid target, so there was nowhere for it to land.

Notes can be rearranged by hand: long-press to select a note, then drag it where you want it. Also fixes short notes floating in the middle of the screen, coloured notes showing a pale slab behind the title and body while editing, and adds an opt-out timestamp prompt right after recording a voice note.

New visual identity, and a redesigned checklist: completed items move into a collapsed section, typing suggests entries you already ticked off, and previews show only what is still to do. Also fixes notes appearing synced when only some relays accepted them, and re-uploads image and voice attachments that a file host has deleted.

Adds signing in with a NIP-46 remote signer ("bunker") on every platform — your private key stays in the signer and never reaches Echoes. Plus a hardening pass on note sync and attachment downloads, and note text back to normal (left-aligned) formatting.

Fixes voice notes being lost over time (their only local copy could be evicted from the OS-purgeable cache). Notes now open as a post-it grid by default, note text is justified, and adding a relay auto-republishes your synced notes to it. Plus two extra default relays and smoother UI touches.

Android signing identity migrated to a dedicated release key (existing Android installs must be reinstalled once — sync or export notes first). Sync cycles are now serialized, fixing a race that could upload attachments twice.
Fixes a UI freeze and crash while typing in the share sheet's recipient search (signature verification moved off the UI thread; contact list no longer refetched on every keystroke).

Multi-user note sharing over Nostr with end-to-end encryption per recipient, NIP-05 recipient lookup, contact autocomplete with visual identity confirmation, and a security hardening pass on all profile/contact fetching.
Security/privacy hardening pass, complete translations for all 27 supported languages, and initial Windows/Linux desktop support.
